export.title: Data export
export.description: Export a server-encrypted project archive. Only one valid archive exists at a time; creating a new one invalidates the old one immediately.
export.warning: Download and keep it safe first. After cancelling the account, project data can only be restored by importing this archive into a new account.

cancel.title: Cancel account
cancel.description: The original login account will no longer be able to sign in, and this cannot be undone. Export your data first.
cancel.warning: This action cannot be undone. You will verify your current password, then your VCode.
cancel.passwordPrompt: Enter your current password. VCode verification follows.
